verdict.rationale: Any publisher of public guidance pages, including a state revenue agency, could ship llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. Direct probes found no such resources: llms.txt and the markdown version of a docs page both return HTTP 404, and no OpenAPI spec exists at any candidate path. The guidance pages are ordinary human-oriented web content.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
